title: Unit Event — Same Dreams, Same Colors — Episode5 Let's Pitch a Tent!

meta.Event Outline: Kohane and the rest of VBS continue practicing in pursuit of greater growth. However, Toya finds himself struggling to understand the vision that his teammates have for a song due to his lack of life experience. That's when Luka offers some advice!

rows.Line: Campground

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, look!
There's a forest right just over that way!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it looks quite big and expansive.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We can leave our stuff here and go check it out. What do you guys think?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We could, but it might be better to get everything set up first before we go, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Like our tents and a campfire...
Also, if we prep for dinner now, we can go on a nice, long walk through the woods!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
Let's do that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we'd have less to worry about later too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, let's start by pitching our tents.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, how does this grove sound?
It's still pretty green even though it's winter.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Looks good.
Alright, let's claim this area.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito and I will pitch our tent here. Why don't you two pitch yours right next door, Azusawa, Shiraishi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's get right to it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... We start by rolling out the tent, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, were there always this many poles? Let's start with one and work our way up from there...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hm? Doesn't this tent belong to your family, An? You've put it together before, right...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Actually, my dad's the one who's good at this and usually just does it by himself in seconds. The last time I really did this was when I was little...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Have you ever done this before, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I went to this local summer camp one time when I was little, so I still sort of remember how to pitch a tent and build a campfire.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I think I'm having trouble now because your tent seems a bit different from the ones we used...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right... Well, let's just keep trying! I'm sure we'll figure something out!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, that should be every pole.
Mind sliding this one through, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sure... So, like this...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
It's really a tent now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we're not done yet. It'll get blown away if we don't clamp it down with some stakes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Right.
You mean these pegs, yes?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
And those two seem to be having some trouble with their tent, so let's go help them once we're done here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay.
Hm? Oh, it's getting windy...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: C-Crap...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hey, the tent's floating...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, at this rate, your family's tent will...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Wah...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
T-Toya?!
What happened?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Sorry, I tripped over something.
I keep forgetting how many rocks there are out here...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just be careful, alright?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: More importantly, what happened to the tent?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, it landed in that clearing over there. Looks like we won't have to sleep outside after all.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay... Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You guys okay?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think so.
Speaking of which, how are you two doing? Your tent was giving you both a lot of trouble based on what I saw.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: W-Well...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It turns out for An's tent that you're supposed to follow a certain order when sticking poles in...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And she forgot to bring the instructions with her, so she's trying to remember each step as we go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Going entirely on your memory seems challenging to say the least...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, especially for this one.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I still remember!
I'm just missing a few pieces is all...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hold on. These kinds of tents usually have their model number printed on their tag. Why don't you use that to look up the instructions on your phone?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, you're right!
The tag should be...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
A tent like this should have its tag...
Yeah, right here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa, you found it so fast!
You're pretty good at this kind of stuff, huh, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Better at it than you to say the least.
Anyway, we gotta get a move on before it gets dark.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, but pitching a tent is turning out to be harder than I remember. Thank goodness I'm a better cook than you, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nice comeback...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But you bring up a good point...
Should we pick out a leader for each part?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Leaders?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, so we know who to turn to if we have questions or run into trouble.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I could be in charge of pitching tents and you could be in charge of cooking, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane said that she knows how to build a campfire, so she can be in charge of that!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I see. Knowing who to turn to regarding each task would streamline things quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But... What would I be in charge of...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're in charge of absorbing as much information as you can. I mean, you're here for the experience, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, we're all in this together, so turn that frown upside down!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, so let's wrap this up.
I'll read out the order, Toya, so can you line up the poles we need as I go?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: An, Kohane, you two are in charge of sticking them in. Once that's done, we can try standing it up together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We did it...!
That was so much quicker when we all worked together!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That means our tent should be a cinch. Let's keep going while we still have momentum.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: *Yawn*...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
There's nothing to do today...
I came all this way, but everyone's out singing somewhere else.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, if you're that bored, why not help me clean the dishes?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm... Maybe I am forgetting to do something...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Sure...
Always with the excuses.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...
Aren't Toya and the others supposed to be going on their camping trip today?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I think I'll go pay them a visit!
